welcomeMet.say: There you are. Washed ashore and on your feet. That is a start.
I am Maren Hale. Come along, and I will show you Overlook.

welcomeMage.say: Whatever the sea gives up, the Mage can tell you what it is.
Bring me what you find. Most of it is worth knowing.

welcomeSmiths.say: Out there, the Grey Tithe take a tenth of whatever a ship carries.
A ship that refuses them is taken whole. So we keep our smiths busy.
Steel that fits. Come back before your next voyage.
And see me before you need to.

welcomeTailorTack.say: Overlook pays the Tithe nothing. No port in the Pale Expanse is more welcoming.
And no ship bound here is shown any mercy. Wear your colours anyway.
Dyes for your armour. Nobody should meet the Tithe looking drab.
And your horse deserves better than that coat.

welcomeVault.say: Three ports still stand. The rest are ruins. Nobody here agrees how they fell.
Whatever you keep in the vault stays here.
Nothing leaves my vault but with the one who left it.
Ask three people who built the beacon and you will hear four names.

welcomeStormcallers.say: Three houses keep the Arts. The Stormcallers keep the Storm, and keep it loud.
Loud is how lightning likes it, Elder.

welcomeVeiled.say: The Veiled keep the Shadow. Ask them nothing you would not want answered.
She is kinder than she sounds.

welcomeLamplighters.say: Mine is the Lamplighters. We keep the Divine. We mend, and light the way.
When you want a house of your own, you know where I stand.
